reason: Author-requested three-row diagram separates agent workflow, dynamic context selection, and engineering knowledge as a resource. The top workflow retains initial context before planning and places the Git precommit admission gate after implementation. The gate requires evidence of refined selection before commit is allowed.

validation.scope: Isolated one-figure production-pipeline proof; not a full-book render. Review-only candidate; existing publication decision is untouched.

checks.icons_and_symbols: The diamond gate follows implementation and produces Commit allowed only after evidence of refined selection. The only dashed edge carries refined scope from planning to selection; it is not a lifecycle feedback loop.
checks.links_and_groups: Workflow: initial agent context → planning → refined agent context → implementation → Git precommit gate → commit allowed. A dispatch hook provides initial selection from anticipated files/components; planning sends a dashed refined-scope edge to the second selection, which uses refined files/dependencies and may add or remove context. Each selection feeds its corresponding context. The same engineering-knowledge repository feeds both selections. Standing instructions remain explicitly available throughout. No lifecycle return edge exists.
checks.annotation_placement: The left margin identifies actor, dynamic selection, and resource rows. At start of task and After planning qualify selection timing; Refined scope labels the dashed planning-to-selection edge. Gate text names Git precommit and evidence of refined selection. Standing instructions are explicitly available throughout.
checks.line_breaks: Whole-word line breaks keep the top workflow legible. The gate diamond uses four short lines at authored 9–10 pt, with Commit allowed outside. No label is silently truncated.

review: Both native and live-text SVG proofs inspected at print size and 2×. Three left-hand row labels organize the workflow, context-selection mechanisms, and resource container. The admission gate is a diamond after implementation, with Commit allowed as its output. Gate text remains at 9–10 pt without scaling; the taller diamond fits in otherwise empty space. The refined-context box was widened slightly to retain label padding. No caption or figure number is embedded, and no flow implies that the precommit gate precedes implementation.
